sql_calls.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments.customer_complaints;

WITH upi_attempts AS (
  SELECT bill_id, attempt, till_status,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bill_id ORDER BY attempt) as rn,
         LAG(till_status) OVER (PARTITION BY bill_id ORDER BY attempt) as prev_status
  FROM payments.pos_payments
  WHERE tender = 'UPI'
    AND ts >= '2026-06-01' AND ts < '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) as retry_count
FROM upi_attempts
WHERE attempt > 1 AND prev_status IN ('declined', 'failed', 'failed: no response');
